initialization_notes: Explicit sigma and e only; temporary gamma is zero-filled, not supplied history. Example100kPaI,e=.7 is not material preparation. Initial yield tolerance is numerical, not exact physical admissibility.

source_parameter_mapping.OpenSees_smooth_cone: After zero hardening/backstress and paired sign conversion: M=3*sqrt(3/2)*rho, Md=3*sqrt(3/2)*rhoBar, c=sigmaY; Atlas gamma=sqrt(2/3)*OpenSees shear multiplier. Separate tensile surface omitted, not equivalent full algorithm.

sigma.project_choice: Constant-elastic radial-return elimination with min(3Ggamma/q_trial_safe,1) and norm subgradient at apex. No separate tensile cutoff.

e.project_choice: Exponential total-volume convention; no effect on elastic/plastic stress law; not full finite-strain kinematics.

gamma.project_choice: Fischer–Burmeister residual with scaled yield. Temporary increment-local multiplier, reset per internal solve.

domain_review.source_recommendation: OpenSees0<=rhoBar<=rho maps to0<=Md<=M; this revision enforces the upper relation through Md<=M and retains nonnegative parameter boxes.
domain_review.dissipation: Prior-definition witness retained in the immutable source review; gamma*((M-Md)*p+c) is nonnegative over the ideal cone for the stated nonnegative parameters and Md<=M.
domain_review.scope: Prior Md>M negative-work witness is excluded by this revision. Frozen native evidence is in this packet; no global applicability or convergence guarantee.
domain_review.nondilatant_tension: M>0,Md0 trial pressure beyond -c/M has no admissible apex volumetric correction; transactional failure expected.
domain_review.degenerate_case: M0,Md0 is pressure-independent J2 yield q<=c. M0,Md>0 lies outside the documented dilatancy restriction.

state_semantics_evidence.sigma: Persistent symmetric effective Cauchy stress under Atlas soil-host interpretation; passive QsigmaQ^T, no spin update. Reference files describe stress and broader material processes.
state_semantics_evidence.e: Persistent project void-ratio scalar, not coupled plastic hardening history.
state_semantics_evidence.gamma: Temporary plastic increment; not accumulated equivalent plastic strain or source hardening state.

transactions.type: Rate-independent incremental residual, no elapsed clock or hold relaxation.
transactions.trial: Committed sigma_n,e_n fixed; trial_s uses committed stress and supplied increment; gamma resets each internal solve.
transactions.commit: Commit sigma/e after success; temporary gamma may appear in returned diagnostics but is not persistent loading history.
transactions.rollback: Failure restores entire incoming layout after tentative internal work. No compiled rollback rerun here.
transactions.subdivision: Returned gamma belongs to last internal solve; full-step and composed solutions must not be conflated.
transactions.zero_load: Admissible unchanged state,gamma0 solves zero-increment residual.
transactions.tangent: Nonsmooth yield/apex and norm at zero; no global smooth tangent/convergence guarantee.
